record.question: Which of the following was the world's first successful electronic computer?
record.explanation: ENIAC is widely described as the first successful general-purpose electronic digital computer; the historical label has qualifications. The intended general-purpose electronic-digital-computer convention is important: specialized or experimental electronic machines predated ENIAC. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://www.computerhistory.org/timeline/computers/; https://archive.computerhistory.org/resources/access/text/2024/04/102750051-05-0002-acc.pdf
